annotations.text:
Three directions for the student dashboard, same data, same tokens as the live app (#1F5E7A accent, #F6F8FA ground, the blue level ramp).

Pick one, then I build it.

A · Quiet document
One column, serif headings, thin rules. Reads like a well-set page: calm, easy on a phone, nothing competes with the next step.

Tradeoff: you scroll to see the whole course, and it looks less like software.

B · Focus band
Dark band puts the next step and its three buttons above everything; tiles, prerequisites and the shortlist sit below in a two-column body.

Tradeoff: the dark band is a strong commitment and eats vertical space on small screens.

C · Course console
All 35 weeks live in a left rail with level dots; the right pane explains the current week as a table with real numbers.

Tradeoff: denser and more technical. Good for advisers and confident students, heavier for a nervous class 12 leaver.
Both of these are drawn in direction A's language. If you pick B or C I redraw them to match before building anything.
